text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Everyone looks so strong… But this is a G3, so I guess I should've expected as much…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Snap out of it, Spe! It's no good thinking about things that'll just make me nervous!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right now, I need to keep my head clear, so I can run this race with all I've got!
